BUSINESS STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.
   B. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.
   C. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.
   C. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Income Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Income Statement.
   B. Say Income Statement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Income Statement as rumours only.
   D. Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Insurance as rumours only.
   B. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.
   D. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.
   C. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.
   D. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   C. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

8. Which statement about Foreign Exchange Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Foreign Exchange Markets never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Foreign Exchange Markets as rumours only.
   C. Explain Foreign Exchange Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Foreign Exchange Markets.

9. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.
   D. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   C. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

12. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   C. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.

13. Which statement about End - Of - Year Adjustments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing End - Of - Year Adjustments.
   B. Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say End - Of - Year Adjustments never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat End - Of - Year Adjustments as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   B. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   D. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.

15. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

16. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Foreign Exchange Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Money Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Inflation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Economic Integration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain National Income and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Networking in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
